title: Let a single-quoted dollar in a test filter keep Engram evidence
outcome: From tm-winf round-11 review (Claude, Note). engram_check_worktree's leads_out rejects any argument containing \$ or % after unquoting, including single-quoted literals bash and PowerShell pass on as written (go test -run '^TestFoo\$', pytest -k 'a\$'). Anchored filters are common, so such runs never yield evidence. Conservative (no false credit) and documented. Option: track quote context per word in engram_shell_word_spans_as and treat \$ inside single quotes as literal for Bash/PowerShell dialects (not %: cmd expands it inside quotes).
